claims.statement: Source mapping does not authorize joins or multi-source workspaces.
Native editing and Undo continue after later agent-driven application.
Prioritize quick dashboard creation by agents or humans over editing existing dashboards.
Prioritize agent-facing checking. Files are possible. A built-in editor starting from pasted text is a tentative entry option.
The document describes the final dashboard. Applying it replaces configuration rather than applying a diff.
Charts work without explicit names. Optional names can make authoring and references easier.
Chart filters restrict that chart for now. Consider adding global filters to the main app and DSL later.
claims.notes: Global filtering is tentative follow-up; local chart scope is explicit.

claims.statement: Use app defaults for omitted settings.
Export DSL on demand after normal UI edits. Continuous text synchronization is unnecessary.
Render as much as possible. Warn clearly about every broken part.
Keep usable results visible. Explain failures with actionable warnings rather than failing the whole workflow.
Avoid JSON in DSL input and output. Verbose identity paths and setting names are acceptable.

complex_value_syntax.decision: Flat paths: a.b=v, key[]=a,b (key[]= empty), key{}= empty object, list records by index (columns.0.width=140), key=unset restores the default, key=null is missing, quoted text is always text, quoted path segments hold dots and spaces.
complex_value_syntax.proof: Round trip of every demo example view, plus package export tests.
